user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template that provisions an S3 bucket suitable for hosting application user uploads with appropriate access controls.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Production-grade S3 bucket for hosting application user uploads with
  encryption, versioning, logging, lifecycle management, and strict access controls.

Parameters:
  BucketNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix for the S3 bucket name (account ID and region will be appended for uniqueness).
    Default: app-user-uploads
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,40}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 bucket name prefix (lowercase, 3-42 chars).

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Deployment environment.
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod

  NoncurrentVersionRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Description: Number of days to retain noncurrent object versions before deletion.
    Default: 90
    MinValue: 1

  TransitionToIADays:
    Type: Number
    Description: Days after which current objects transition to STANDARD_IA storage.
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 30

  TransitionToGlacierDays:
    Type: Number
    Description: Days after which current objects transition to GLACIER storage.
    Default: 180
    MinValue: 90

  AbortIncompleteMultipartUploadDays:
    Type: Number
    Description: Days after which incomplete multipart uploads are aborted.
    Default: 7
    MinValue: 1

  AllowedCorsOrigin:
    Type: String
    Description: Allowed CORS origin for browser-based uploads (use specific origin in production).
    Default: 'https://example.com'

Resources:
  UploadsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS CMK for encrypting ${BucketNamePrefix} S3 bucket objects'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: uploads-kms-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3ServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'

  UploadsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${BucketNamePrefix}-${Environment}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref UploadsKmsKey

  AccessLogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${BucketNamePrefix}-${Environment}-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireOldLogs
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 30
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: S3AccessLogs

  AccessLogsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AccessLogsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowS3ServerAccessLogging
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${AccessLogsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${BucketNamePrefix}-${Environment}-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AccessLogsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AccessLogsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  UploadsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolic
